# use-rust

RustUse rust utilities and facade set.

## Set links

- Canonical set page: https://rustuse.org/use-rust/
- Set overview alias: https://rustuse.org/sets/use-rust/
- Workspace Rustdocs: https://rustuse.org/api/workspaces/use-rust/
- Repository: https://github.com/RustUse/use-rust
- Root LLM routing map: https://rustuse.org/llms.txt
- Full RustUse context: https://rustuse.org/llms-full.txt

## Parent RustUse links

- Primary site: https://rustuse.org/
- Onboarding docs: https://rustuse.org/onboarding/
- Set docs overview: https://rustuse.org/sets/
- Crate docs overview: https://rustuse.org/crates/
- Contributing: https://rustuse.org/contributing/
- GitHub organization: https://github.com/RustUse

## Full set context

- [Full use-rust LLM context](https://rustuse.org/use-rust/llms-full.txt)

The set `llms.txt` keeps routing, workspace Rustdocs, and crate links for this set. Use `use-rust/llms-full.txt` when fuller set-level context is needed.
